title: LiDAR module, all core PCBAs made in Thailand (Hesai OT128)
description: A move that does not change origin: moving only the RX/TX boards to Vietnam keeps Thailand; CBP held Vietnam only when all four core PCBAs were made there (N359371, N363700).
source: CBP rulings N359371 (25 Mar 2026) and N363700 (7 Aug 2026), rulings.cbp.gov

product.name: Hesai OT128 LiDAR module
product.description: A 360-degree automotive LiDAR sensor that measures distances with laser beams and creates 3-dimensional maps for autonomous driving and logistics. It is composed of a top cover, cover lens, lens housing (opto-mechanical unit with RX module, TX module, lenses and top main board) and base (with the bottom main board, motor and wireless power supply).

components.name: lenses, laser emitters and detectors, flexible printed circuits, brackets, heat sink, motor, covers, base and all other components

operations.name: assemble the RX and TX modules, the lens housing, top main board and base at automated, bonding and fastening stations
cure, calibrate, test and inspect 100% of modules

economics.duty_rates_note: Duty rates come from the sourced table for HTS 9015.80.20 (classification inferred, docs/DUTY-SOURCES.md, D52); the import value and group costs are illustrative.
